reviewNotes: This batch reviews 80 furniture runtime records. Every player-visible display name is delegated by field 7 to the Romanian Strings/Furniture localization target; the leading English value is a legacy internal name and every remaining field is runtime metadata. Each record is therefore retained byte-exact with an explicit reason.

JojaCrate.preservationReason: Furniture runtime data only: the leading English value is an internal legacy name, field 7 is a LocalizedText lookup into the Romanian Strings/Furniture localization target, and all type, geometry, rotation, price, placement, tilesheet and collection fields are preserved byte-exact.
